mapper.select: SELECT ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'MART' THEN 1 END) AS mart_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'BANK' THEN 1 END) AS bank_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN p.category = 'DEPARTMENT_STORE' THEN 1 END) AS department_store_count FROM admin_dongs ad LEFT JOIN places p ON p.admin_dong_id = ad.admin_dong_id AND p.category IN ('MART', 'BANK', 'DEPARTMENT_STORE') GROUP BY ad.admin_dong_id, ad.dong_population, ad.dong_area
